title: Understanding Mean-Centering
text: Mean-centering involves subtracting the mean of each column from the respective column values, except for the intercept column. This process ensures that the mean of each column is zero.

title: Effect of Mean-Centering on Regression Coefficients
text: When data is mean-centered, the intercept term in the regression model becomes zero. This is because the mean of the response variable is subtracted from each observation, aligning the data around the origin.

title: Comparing Coefficients: Centered vs. Uncentered
text: The coefficients for the non-intercept terms (slopes) remain the same whether the data is centered or not. This is because mean-centering does not affect the relationships between the variables, only the intercept.

hintAnswer: The intercept term in the centered model is zero.
